name: @bridgingx/mcp-kit
description: Shared platform MCP plumbing for BridgingX products (Phase 0): pluggable bearer verification (HS256 now, JWKS later without consumer change), fail-closed caller→tenant resolution, the mandatory three-gate tool-call sequencer, one audit shape with an injected writer, tool-registry conventions with declared exposure grain, and a uniform denial shape that never reveals whether a resource exists. No database access — products supply gates, writers and limiters as functions (Architecture Consolidation PRD, MCP section; DR-2026-08-29-03; DR-2026-09-01-01).
